briefs.purpose: The workspace lists guidance-core, fluent-router, common-core, and search-vector as members.
Coral Router routes requests; Guidance mirrors the tree; shared crates carry the reuse.
A file is complete exactly when its sidecar is strictly newer than its source.
Sidecars carry per-file facts; every index is derived and rebuildable from them.
Promotion needs a passing entry on point, model fingerprint, and question version.
Seed corpora carry the tune split; held-out cases are reported, never tuned against.
Deterministic fixers run before any model; nothing exact is ever re-decided.
Capability cards answer what a crate can do, ranked by SVO overlap.
Staleness compares stored hashes against live bytes before regenerating a sidecar.
The guidance binary owns sync, search, scorecard, and the benchmark arms.
Done means the mirror is fresh, the build is clean, and nothing waits without an owner.
The import plane resolves each card to a live section and stores ready or a gap.
Ranked briefs feed ordering only; unjudged briefs stay considered until calibrated.
The read plane answers from the mirror; the maintain plane converges it.
The capabilities table stores briefs by id with FTS over title and purpose.
Shared helpers live in common-core; new copies are composed, never reimplemented.
Eval goldens pin section order, citations, and envelope shape on a fixed fixture.
Fixture hybrids decide sync reprocessing for fixture inputs after an edit.

cases.query: What are the major components of this codebase?
Which crate owns calibration, and how is a decision point promoted?
How does guidance sync decide what to reprocess after an edit?
Where do capability briefs come from and what consumes them?
What is the zzqy nonexistent subsystem?
